newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shrs crawl higher on Dow after data delayed.
newsitem.headline: Chile shrs crawl higher on Dow after data delayed.

text.p: Chilean blue chips rose a notch in quiet morning turnover, with the market taking its cue from Wall Street after the government delayed release of April inflation and quarterly unemployment figures till Tuesday, brokers said.
They saw no clear direction ahead in trading and said there was little local news to guide the market.
The IPSA index of the 40 most-traded shares rose 0.28 percent to 119.67 points. The all-share IGPA edged up 0.04 percent 5359.01 points.
Analysts expect April consumer inflation to rise 0.3 percent, though it is expected to increase by 0.4 or 0.5 percent in May, partly due to the effects of the drought in central Chile on food prices.

The business organization Sofofa released figures showing declining industrial production in March and the first quarter, in the latest sign of sluggish economic growth despite a Central Bank rate cut. The new figures looked certain to add pressure for another rate cut later this year.
Risers included Endesa, up 0.7 percent to 261 pesos, and Concha y Toro, which rose 0.7 percent to 270 pesos after releasing strong first quarter earnings.
